summary: Tested WFH/Remote tab in HR Admin > Approvals section. All features working correctly - Remote tab displays, filters work, WFH request cards show comprehensive details, View/Approve/Reject modals function properly.
seed_data_creation: Created test WFH requests during backend testing (cleaned up after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: WFH/Remote tab fully tested. Features verified: 1) Remote tab exists in HR Admin > Approvals with correct count badge 2) Filters work: Status (Pending/Approved/Rejected/All), Employee dropdown, Date Range 3) WFH request cards display all details: employee name, status badge, days badge, dates, location, contact, reason, work plan, requested date 4) View button opens WFH Request Details modal with full information 5) Approve button opens modal with remarks textarea and LOP deduction checkbox 6) Reject button opens modal with required reason textarea 7) Backend APIs all working: create, get pending, get all with filters, get single, approve with remarks, reject with reason, cancel

remote_tab_exists.details: Remote tab visible in Approvals section with count badge showing pending requests

status_filter.details: Status dropdown works with Pending/Approved/Rejected/All options

employee_filter.details: Employee dropdown lists employees with WFH requests

date_range_filter.details: Date range inputs present and functional

wfh_request_card.details: Cards display: employee name, status badge (Pending/Approved/Rejected), days badge, dates, location, contact, reason, work plan, requested date

view_details_modal.details: Modal shows comprehensive details: employee info with avatar, email, status badge, start/end dates, total days, work location, contact number, reason, work plan, and action buttons

approve_modal.details: Modal shows employee name, remarks textarea (optional), LOP deduction checkbox, Cancel and Approve buttons

reject_modal.details: Modal shows employee name, rejection reason textarea (required), Cancel and Reject buttons

approved_request_display.details: Approved requests show green badge and 'Approved with remarks' text

rejected_request_display.details: Rejected requests show red badge and 'Rejection reason' text

backend_create_wfh.details: POST /api/hr/wfh/request creates WFH request with all fields

backend_get_pending.details: GET /api/hr/wfh/pending returns pending requests for HR admin

backend_get_all_with_filters.details: GET /api/hr/wfh/all supports status, employee, date filters

backend_approve.details: POST /api/hr/wfh/{id}/approve updates status and stores remarks

backend_reject.details: POST /api/hr/wfh/{id}/reject requires reason and updates status
